title: Small Group Vancouver Tour with Capilano Suspension Bridge
includes: Luggage Allowance (1 checked bag per person)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Limited to 8 guests per departure, this small group tour offers a relaxed and more personal introduction to Vancouver's most iconic neighborhoods and attractions.

Enjoy guided stops at Stanley Park and Gastown’s famous Steam Clock, plus drive-throughs of Canada Place, Coal Harbour, and historic Chinatown. Then head into nature at Capilano Suspension Bridge Park — cross the legendary bridge, explore the treetop walkways, and take in the views from the thrilling Cliffwalk.

A relaxed, well-paced experience, with fewer crowds and more personal space — ideal for travelers who want comfort, connection, and stunning scenery in a half-day tour.

SEMI-PRIVATE TOUR:
